lessons.title: Tanishuv: This is ... / These are ...
lessons.goal: Bugun kimnidir tanishtirishni, "bu — ..." deb aytishni va birlik-ko'plikni farqlashni o'rganasiz. 25 ta so'z — kundalik muloqot va odamlar haqida.

frame.name: This is ... / These are ...
frame.formula:
This is  + birlik ot      →  This is my friend.
These are + ko'plik ot    →  These are my friends.
That is   + uzoqdagi narsa →  That is my car.
frame.explain: Ingliz tilida "bu" degan so'z otning birlik yoki ko'pligiga qarab o'zgaradi: this — birlik, these — ko'plik. Shunga mos ravishda fe'l ham o'zgaradi: is (birlik) va are (ko'plik). O'zbekchada "bu mening do'stim" va "bular mening do'stlarim" deymiz — ingliz tilida farq faqat ikkita so'zda: this → these, is → are.

short: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

examples.en: This is my friend Aziz.
This is a kind person.
These are my neighbors.
This is not a stranger, this is my partner.
examples.uz: Bu notanish odam emas, bu mening sherigim.

examples.en: Is this your team?
These are young people, not teenagers.
This is a woman from our team.
That is a little child with his mother.

street.title: Ko'chada: qisqa tanishuv
street.note: Buddy va guy — norasmiy, lekin odobsiz emas. E'tibor bering: person so'zining ko'pligi people bo'ladi — two people, "two persons" emas.

lines.en: Hi! Are you new here?
Hi, yes. I'm Aziz, a student.
Nice to meet you. This is my colleague, Laylo.
Hello, Laylo. Is this your team?
No, these are just our guests.
What a pity — I want to meet the team.

translate.en: That is a very kind person.

lessons.tip: This / these — qo'lingizdagi yoki yaqin narsa; that / those — uzoqdagi. O'zbekchada bu farq yo'q, ingliz tilida esa majburiy: This is my pen (qo'limdagi) va That is my pen (anavi stoldagi).

lessons.title: Kasb: I am a doctor, she is a nurse
lessons.goal: Kim bo'lib ishlashni aytish, kasb haqida savol berish va a/an artiklini to'g'ri qo'yishni o'rganasiz.

frame.name: to be + kasb
frame.formula:
I am a teacher.        He is a driver.
I am not a boss.       Is she a nurse?
They are students.     Are you a student?
frame.explain: Kasbni aytganda to be fe'li va a/an artikli kerak: I am a doctor. O'zbekchada "men shifokorman" deymiz, inglizchada esa "I doctor" emas — fe'l tushib qolmasin. Kasb ko'plikda bo'lsa artikl qo'yilmaydi: They are teachers.
table: a teacher, a doctor, a worker
an + unli tovush (a, e, i, o, u)
an engineer, an artist, an actor

short: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.

examples.en: I am a student, and my brother is a driver.
She is an engineer at a big company.
My boss is not a doctor — he is a businessman.
Are you a teacher or a student?
They are nurses at the city hospital.
Our accountant is on vacation, so the manager is busy.
examples.uz: Buxgalterimiz ta'tilda, shuning uchun menejer band.

examples.en: He is a famous actor, and his wife is a journalist.
examples.uz: U mashhur aktyor, xotini esa jurnalist.

examples.en: Are these new employees from the office?

street.title: Ish haqida qisqa gaplar
street.note: "I am a doctor" — kasb. "I am doctor" xato: a/an tushib qolmasin. Ammo "I am the director" deyish ham mumkin — bu holda gap aniq bir lavozim haqida.

lines.en: Hi, I'm Kamola. I'm a new employee here.
lines.uz: Salom, men Kamola. Bu yerda yangi xodimman.

lines.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Sardor, the sales manager.
lines.uz: Tanishganimdan xursandman. Men Sardor, savdo menejeri.

lines.en: Are you the boss?
No, our director is Mr Karimov. I'm just a manager.
lines.uz: Yo'q, direktorimiz Karimov janoblari. Men faqat menejerman.

lines.en: And who is that man near the window?
That's our accountant — he is also a lawyer.
lines.uz: Bu bizning buxgalter — u ham yurist.

fix.wrong: Are you a student? — Yes, I are.

lessons.tip: a yoki an — talaffuzga qarab tanlanadi, harfga emas: an hour (h aytilmaydi), a university (yu tovushi bilan boshlanadi), an MBA (em).

lessons.title: Oila: I have got a brother
lessons.goal: "Menda ... bor" strukturasini o'zlashtirasiz: have got / has got, inkor va savol shakllari, oila a'zolari lug'ati.

frame.name: have got / has got
frame.formula:
I / you / we / they  + have got  + ot
to have got
he / she / it        + has got   + ot
I've got a sister.     She's got two children.
frame.explain: have got — "ega bo'lish"ning so'zlashuv shakli, ma'nosi have bilan bir xil. Inkor: haven't got / hasn't got; savol: Have you got ...? / Has she got ...? E'tibor bering: o'zbekchadagi "menda bor" ni so'zma-so'z tarjima qilib bo'lmaydi — "in me there is" emas, I have got.

aff: We have got a big family.
short: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.

examples.en: I have got a big family: my parents, two sisters and a brother.
examples.uz: Mening katta oilam bor: ota-onam, ikki singlim va akam.

examples.en: She hasn't got a husband, but she has got a son.
examples.uz: Uning eri yo'q, lekin o'g'li bor.

examples.en: Have you got any cousins in Tashkent?
My grandfather is sixty, and his twin brother is also sixty.
examples.uz: Buam oltmishda, uning egizak akasi ham oltmishda.

examples.en: We haven't got a baby in our family yet.
My niece is single, and her sister is married.
examples.uz: Jiyanim turmush qurmagan, singlisi esa turmush qurgan.

examples.en: Have you got a relative at the wedding?
Our parents have got a small house, and we have got a flat.
examples.uz: Ota-onamizning kichik uyi bor, bizning esa kvartiramiz bor.

street.title: Oila haqida jonli savollar
street.note: have got ko'proq Britaniya inglizida, "Do you have kids?" esa amerikacha — ikkisi ham to'g'ri. "You got kids?" — savol ohangi bilan, yordamchi fe'lsiz, norasmiy.

lines.en: Have you got a big family?
Yes, I've got three sisters and one brother.
lines.uz: Ha, uch singlim va bir akam bor.

lines.en: And are they married?
One sister is married, the others are single.
Have you got a niece or a nephew?
I've got a little niece — she is only a baby.
lines.uz: Kichkina jiyanim bor — u hali chaqaloq.

substitution.prompt: We ___ got a big family. (have / has)
substitution.answer: We have got a big family.

translate.en: This is my grandmother and my grandfather.

fix.wrong: Have you got a sister? — Yes, I have got.
fix.why: qisqa javobda faqat yordamchi fe'l qoladi

lessons.tip: "Bor" so'zini har doim ham tarjima qilmang. Ega bo'lish — have got / have: I have got a car. Biror joyda mavjudlik — there is / there are: There is a car in the yard. Bu farqni 3 va 4-darslarda yonma-yon ko'rasiz.

lessons.title: Nima bor? There is / There are
lessons.goal: "Biror joyda nima bor" ni aytishni o'rganasiz: there is / there are, inkor va savol. 25 ta hayvon nomi bilan mashq qilasiz.

frame.name: There is / There are
frame.formula:
There is  + birlik ot     → There is a cat on the sofa.
There are + ko'plik ot     → There are two dogs in the yard.
There isn't / There aren't  → inkor
Is there ...? / Are there ...? → savol
frame.explain: There is / There are o'zbekchadagi "bor" so'zining eng ko'p ishlatiladigan ko'rinishi, lekin u ega bo'lishni emas, joyda mavjudlikni bildiradi. I have got a dog — itim bor (mening). There is a dog in the yard — hovlida it bor. Gap boshida there turadi, o'zbekchadagi kabi joy oxirida keladi.

aff: There is a dog in the yard.
There are three cats on the sofa.
neg: There isn't a dog in the yard.
q: Is there a pet shop near here?
Are there any birds in the tree?
short: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

examples.en: There is a cat on the roof.
There are two horses and a cow in the yard.
examples.uz: Hovlida ikki ot va bir sigir bor.

examples.en: There isn't a zoo in our town.
Is there a pet shop near your house?
examples.uz: Uyingiz yaqinida uy hayvonlari do'koni bormi?

examples.en: There are many birds in the tree, and one squirrel.
examples.uz: Daraxtda ko'p qushlar va bitta olmaxon bor.

examples.en: There aren't any wolves near the village.
My pet is a rabbit with a short tail.
examples.uz: Mening uy hayvonim — kalta dumli quyon.

examples.en: Are there elephants and giraffes in this zoo?
examples.uz: Bu hayvonot bog'ida fillar va jirafalar bormi?

street.title: Hayvon haqida jonli gaplar

items.en: We've got a cat at home.

street.note: there's — there is. Ko'plikda "there're" deyish mumkin, lekin ko'pincha shunchaki "there are" aytiladi.

lines.en: Is there a pet shop near here?
lines.uz: Bu yaqinda uy hayvonlari do'koni bormi?

lines.en: Yes, there is one next to the market.
I've got a small rabbit, and I need food for it.
lines.uz: Kichkina quyonim bor, unga ovqat kerak.

lines.en: Are there any rabbits in your yard?
No, there aren't. Only a cat and two ducks.
lines.uz: Yo'q. Faqat mushuk va ikki o'rdak bor.

lines.en: Great — my daughter loves animals.

substitution.prompt: There ___ a cat on the chair. (be)
substitution.answer: There is a cat on the chair.

substitution.prompt: There ___ two dogs in the yard. (be)
substitution.answer: There are two dogs in the yard.

substitution.prompt: ___ there a zoo in the city? (be)
substitution.answer: Is there a zoo in the city?

substitution.prompt: There ___ any mice in the kitchen. (inkor)
substitution.answer: There aren't any mice in the kitchen.

substitution.prompt: There ___ a rat under the bed. (be)
substitution.answer: There is a rat under the bed.

translate.uz: Hovlida bir ot va ikki sigir bor.
translate.en: There is a horse and two cows in the yard.
Is there a zoo near here?
My dog has got a long tail.

fix.wrong: There are a dog in the yard.
fix.right: There is a dog in the yard.

lessons.tip: Bir nechta ot sanalsa, fe'l eng yaqin otga moslashadi: There is a horse and two cows ham, There are two cows and a horse ham to'g'ri.

lessons.title: Qayerda yashaysiz? Present Simple
lessons.goal: Doimiy holat va odat haqida gapirish: Present Simple, he/she/it uchun -s, inkor va savol. Shahar joylari lug'ati.

frame.name: Present Simple: I live / she works
frame.formula:
I / you / we / they + fe'l        → I live in Tashkent.
he / she / it + fe'l + s          → She works at a bank.
I don't live here.               Do you live here?
frame.explain: Present Simple — doimiy holat, odat va takrorlanadigan ishlar uchun. Fe'l o'zgarmaydi, faqat he / she / it bilan -s qo'shiladi. Savol va inkorda esa -s yordamchi fe'lga o'tadi: She works → Does she work? → She doesn't work.

aff: My sister works at a hotel.
We go to the cinema on Sundays.
neg: I don't live in the village.
She doesn't work at a bank.
q: Do you live near the station?
Does he work at the airport?
short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

examples.en: I live in a small village near the station.
examples.uz: Men bekat yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda yashayman.

examples.en: She works at the post office in the city center.
My parents don't live in this building.
Does your brother study at the university?
We go to the cafe near the theater every Friday.
examples.uz: Biz har juma teatr yonidagi kafega boramiz.

examples.en: He doesn't work at the hospital — he works at the airport.
There is a cinema behind the bank, and a small restaurant next to it.
examples.uz: Bank orqasida kinoteatr va uning yonida kichik restoran bor.

examples.en: Do you live in a house or in a hotel?

street.title: Yo'l so'rash va joy haqida

items.en: How do I get to the station?
Go out of the main entrance.

street.note: home so'zi bilan predlog va artikl ishlatilmaydi: go home, at home — "go to home" xato.

lines.en: Where do you live?
I live in a small house near the airport.
Does your wife work in the city center?
No, she works at a hotel near the station.
lines.uz: Yo'q, u bekat yaqinidagi mehmonxonada ishlaydi.

lines.en: Is there a good cafe near your house?
Yes, there is a cafe and a small cinema behind the bank.
lines.uz: Ha, bank orqasida kafe va kichik kinoteatr bor.

substitution.prompt: ___ he study at the university? (do / does)
substitution.answer: Does he study at the university?
I don't live in the center.

substitution.prompt: He ___ to the cinema on Sundays. (go)
substitution.answer: He goes to the cinema on Sundays.

translate.en: I live in the city center.
She doesn't work at a hotel.
Do you live near the school?
My brother studies at the university.

fix.wrong: He live in a big house.
fix.right: He lives in a big house.

fix.wrong: She don't work at the hospital.
fix.right: She doesn't work at the hospital.

fix.wrong: Do he live near the airport?
fix.right: Does he live near the airport?

lessons.tip: -s qo'shish qoidasi: work → works; watch → watches (ch, sh, s, x, o bilan tugasa -es); study → studies (undosh + y → -ies); play → plays (unli + y → faqat -s).
